exam_name: Microsoft Dynamics 365: Core Finance and Operations

testing_centers.notes: Available at Certiport Authorized Testing Centers (primarily academic)

id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID. Name on ID must match registration. For online: webcam required, room must be clear of people and materials.
exam_rules: No notes, books, or study materials. No phones or smartwatches. Whiteboard or scratch paper may be provided by testing center. Online: no dual monitors, no virtual machines, no headphones, must be alone in a closed room.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: No waiting period for first retake if score >= 500 on failed attempt. If score < 500: 14-day waiting period before retake. Maximum 5 attempts per exam per year (365 days). Free retake voucher sometimes included in official instructor-led training.

editorial.meta_description: Microsoft retired the MB-300 exam on 2024-02-29. This assessment had no successor.
editorial.overview: Microsoft officially retired the MB-300 exam on 2024-02-29. This professional assessment was designed to evaluate a candidate's proficiency in core finance and operations functionality, security configuration, data management, and solution validation. The exam consisted of 40 questions in total. As there is no successor, candidates should consult Microsoft for current certification paths.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam was intended for functional consultants, system administrators, and technical professionals who worked with Microsoft Dynamics 365 finance and operations applications and needed to validate their core configuration and implementation skills.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Because the MB-300 exam is retired, you cannot schedule or sit for it. Instead, focus your study on current Microsoft documentation and training resources covering Dynamics 365 core finance and operations features. Transfer your understanding of role-based security, data management, and system configuration to active credentials. Reviewing official Microsoft learning paths remains the best way to maintain your technical expertise in these specific business applications.

domain_guidance.summary: Candidates were expected to master common functionality and implementation tools to set up and navigate finance and operations apps effectively, ensuring they could manage system settings and user interfaces according to standard organizational requirements.
study_focus: Overall functionality of finance and operations apps

domain_guidance.summary: This domain required the ability to configure role-based security, business processes, and system options to control user access and align with organizational structure, ensuring that security roles were assigned correctly to meet specific business needs.

Candidates needed to handle Finance and Operations data, integration modes, and data management workspaces while maintaining security boundaries, ensuring that data entities were correctly utilized to support seamless integration across various business systems and environments.

This domain focused on the ability to validate and support the solution using testing tools, service updates, and maintenance guidelines for cloud or on-premises environments, ensuring that all system updates were managed without disrupting business operations.
study_focus: Managing security objects after a service update

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Since Microsoft retired this exam on 2024-02-29, it cannot be scheduled or taken at any testing center. Please review current Microsoft certification options for active assessments that align with your professional development goals.

faq.question_title: How many questions were on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam contained 40 questions presented in a linear format using various question types such as multiple choice, multiple response, drag and drop, case study, build list, hot area, and repeated answer choices.

The passing score for this certification exam was 700 on a scale of 1-1000. Candidates were required to meet or exceed this threshold to demonstrate their proficiency in the core finance and operations subject matter.

The total duration of the exam was 100 minutes. This time limit was provided to allow candidates to complete all 40 questions, including complex case studies and various interactive question types found within the assessment.

The price of the exam was 165.0 USD. This fee covered the cost of the assessment at the time it was available for scheduling through the official Microsoft certification portal before the retirement date.

methodology.summary: This overview was compiled using official Microsoft certification pages and documentation to provide accurate historical details on the retired MB-300 exam, ensuring that all information reflects the official status and content of the assessment.
